An analysis of the company's financial profile reveals a solid balance sheet but relatively weak profitability. The issuer demonstrates strong liquidity with a current ratio of 2.57, moderate leverage (debt-to-equity and equity-to-assets indicate a reasonable capital structure with equity of 2,858M supporting 6,927M in assets), and a substantial cushion of retained earnings (2,355M). However, profitability is thin, with an operating margin of only 6.4% (244M operating income on 3,801M revenue) and a low net profit margin of 0.8% (32M net income), which limits its cash flow generation relative to its size and places it in the investment-grade borderline category.

DECISION: BBB-
